summary: Realty Income Corp filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for an offering of €600 million aggregate principal amount of 3.625% Notes due 2032. The notes are senior unsecured obligations, issued at 99.518% of par, with an underwriting discount of 0.650% and net proceeds of approximately €593.2 million before expenses. The notes mature July 30, 2032, and are callable at the company's option. Delivery is book-entry via Clearstream and Euroclear, with settlement on or about July 7, 2026. The filing is a routine debt offering, not a special situation. No special-situation deal terms apply.
